product.name: No Code Mobile App Builder
product.description: A platform that allows users to create mobile apps for their Shopify stores without coding, featuring real-time syncing, drag-and-drop components, push notifications, and app-specific promotions.

product.name: Ali Reviews
product.description: An app for managing product reviews, offering automated review requests, customizable widgets, review analytics, and SEO optimization.

product.name: Adjust
product.description: A tool for attribution, analytics, fraud prevention, and campaign optimization, providing dynamic user segments and raw data access.

product.name: AfterPay
product.description: A finance app enabling interest-free installment payments, supporting both in-store and online transactions.

product.name: Algolia Search and Discovery
product.description: An AI-powered search solution that delivers accurate search results using natural language understanding and real-time query suggestions.

product.name: Apple Pay
product.description: A digital wallet and mobile payment service by Apple, facilitating fast and secure payments.
